title: From PAC bounds on the generalization error to PAC bounds on the parameter estimation error
abstract: arXiv:2611.09767v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Probably Approximately Correct (PAC) bounds on the generalization error, the difference between the true prediction error and the empirical prediction error, are an established tool in statistical machine learning, and there have been several extensions of these bounds to dynamical systems. In parallel, in recent years, there has been growing interest in finite-sample bounds for parameter estimation error in system identification. The latter bounds tend to be algorithm-specific, relying on reformulating the identification algorithm as a least-squares regression problem. This is in contrast to classical PAC bounds, which are algorithm-agnostic and can be applied to any identification algorithm based on minimizing a cost function involving the empirical loss. translated_title: 从泛化误差的PAC界到参数估计误差的PAC界
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.09767v2 公告类型： 替换 摘要：泛化误差（即真实预测误差与经验预测误差之差）的PAC（概率近似正确）界是统计机器学习中一种成熟的分析工具，并且这些界已有多个针对动态系统的扩展。与此同时，近年来，系统辨识中参数估计误差的有限样本界引起了越来越多的关注。后一类界往往是针对特定算法的，依赖于将辨识算法重新表述为最小二乘回归问题。这与经典的PAC界形成鲜明对比——经典PAC界与算法无关，可应用于任何基于最小化包含经验损失的代价函数的辨识算法。在本文中，我们展示了如何利用从PAC界导出的oracle界来获得动态系统的有限样本界。作为该方法的一个例证，我们提出了……
tldr: 本文提出了一种将经典PAC泛化误差界通过oracle界转化为动态系统参数估计误差有限样本界的方法，从而把算法无关的PAC界推广到系统辨识的参数估计误差分析中。
en_tdlr: This paper shows how oracle bounds derived from algorithm-agnostic PAC generalization error bounds can be used to obtain finite-sample bounds on parameter estimation error for dynamical systems, bridging learning-theoretic generalization bounds and system identification.
